jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Data & Analytics

Pay Details

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

As Associate Vice President, Financial Crime Risk Management (FCRM) Data Management, Canada, you will lead the team responsible for strengthening the data foundations that support TD’s financial crime risk management capabilities. Reporting to the Vice President, FCRM Monitoring Coverage and Capabilities, you will help shape the FCRM data strategy and lead data governance, data delivery and the continued evolution of the Canadian data management operating model. Working with business, technology and enterprise data partners, you will advance data quality, stewardship and controls, oversee transaction monitoring exception management, and support new business initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to connect strategic direction with execution, helping safeguard the Bank and its customers through effective data management and risk oversight.

Depth And Scope

Contribute to the design of the FCRM Data Strategy, aligned to overall FCRM business strategy and roadmap
Lead the Data Management team to create and be responsible for policies, procedures, standard methodologies and frameworks to govern how the data is collected, stored, enriched, structured, managed, and accessed.
Lead data delivery for new business initiatives across all FCRM capabilities. Ensure the appropriate Data Stewardship roles are engaged to oversee data management across FCRM processes and related projects and programs.
Understand and adheres to the Enterprise Data & Information Management Standards defined by the Enterprise Data Management Organization (EDMO).
Build and mature FCRM data management operating model.
Lead Exceptions Management process for Transaction Monitoring
Manage a team of AML and data management professionals to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions).
Present findings, highlight de-risking opportunities and identify risk mitigation and program enhancement opportunities to FCRM colleagues, stakeholders, and senior management
Identify, review, propose solutions to address, and escalate significant AML/sanctions issues and activities to FCRM and Bank senior management and assess complex issues, structure potential solutions, and drive effective resolution with other senior stakeholders
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the bank's reputation and safeguarding the Bank, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policy, applying sound ethical judgment, and escalating, managing and reporting AML risks and control issues with transparency.

Education And Experience

Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Data Management, Computer Science, Information Management, Risk Management, or a related discipline required.
Master's degree (MBA, Data Analytics, Information Management, or related field) considered an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in Financial Crime Risk Management, Data Management, Data Governance, Risk Management, Compliance, or related disciplines.
10+ years of leadership experience managing teams and leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives.
CAMS, CFCS, CDMP, DCAM, or equivalent AML/Data Management certification preferred.
Knowledge of EDMO/Enterprise Data Management standards and data governance frameworks required

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

30 Adelaide Str, East

Toronto, Ontario, M5C 3G9

Canada

Who We Are

With its global headquarters in Toronto, Canada, International Financial Data Services (IFDS) is a world-leading provider of outsourcing and technology solutions to the financial services industry. IFDS services over 240 financial organizations around the world, providing solutions to a wide range of global asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and insurance companies. The IFDS enterprise supports more than 17 million accounts with AUA of approximately CAD $4 trillion. IFDS Canada is a 50/50 joint ventures between Boston-based State Street Corporation, one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, and Connecticut-based SS&C Technologies, a global provider of investment and financial software-enabled services and software for the global financial services and healthcare industries.

Imagine yourself at IFDS

Come experience a community like no other at International Financial Data Services (IFDS). We offer work opportunities driven by a passion for creating market leading financial solutions, and a culture that nurtures collaboration, accountability, diversity & inclusion, and continuous learning. We’ll provide you with opportunities to develop your career. From ongoing training and development programs to experiences working with our global financial services partners, you’ll be able to realize your full potential.

Role Overview

The Governance Director – Client Account Management provides day to day oversight; guidance and strategic leadership to our client and the broader support team at IFDS and SS&C through close collaboration with the Business Development Relationship Manager, the AMS team, IT Departments; the Business Solutions and Planning team and C-Suite individuals to ensure the delivery of superior service commitments aligned with client goals. The incumbent will own the overall oversight of key initiatives and changes impacting the client, identifying risks and issues and will be responsible for the timely closure of all remediation actions. The Director will provide guidance and leadership, coaching and development to managers and employees to ensure that clients are supported with high quality solutions tailored to their business needs.

Governance

Role Responsibilities

Oversee a virtual support team consisting of both IFDS and SS&C individuals dedicated to the overall successful delivery of changes.
Build and maintain a governance practice consisting of key reporting and metrics tracking all initiatives/changes / issues - identifying and addressing risks and issues to continuously enhance service, client relationships and improve operational efficiencies.
Acts as an escalation point for the client re any key changes.
Lead the identification and documentation of risks and controls across changes and initiatives (projects, service requests, incidents and adhoc initiatives such as proactive testing of complex functionality).
Elevate the profile and product knowledge of clients by providing deep expertise in risk and controls in conjunction with virtual support team.
Implement an internal/ external forum/s to meet regularly with the “virtual” support teams (and the client) to provide and discuss status of changes/issues and hold teams accountable to timely resolution and remediation actions.
Ongoing assessment of venues / documentation and ensures all processes serve a key purpose and align with client and IFDS requirements. E.g. any “special client reporting” from CAMs – Vendor Scorecard; Usage reporting; Utilization reporting etc. Delivers to client (along with new findings/solutions etc)
Ongoing review processes/operating model etc. to ensure “we evolve our processes and engagement” aligned with iA’s evolution in business growth and strategy
Overseas the SLA adherence and smooth delivery of client requests, to ensure delivery is in accordance with client expectations
Work directly with the client and internal teams to ensure clarity and organization of all changes and release/ delivery dates.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, business partners to ensure effective collaboration and communication.
Drive change management initiatives, guiding the team through evolving operational risk management standards and expectations.
Foster a team environment and culture that encourages productivity, innovation, process improvement, and professionalism.

Account Management Service Delivery

Oversees day-to-day issue resolution and all critical reoccurring processes for clients, which includes planning and execution of the overall client service delivery experience in collaboration with all internal and external clients to oversee the delivery of superior customer service in alignment with the client’s strategic goals 
Interacts directly with key business partners, developing and maintaining a strong on-going relationship; always looking for opportunities to improve client satisfaction and experience
Facilitates and leads various internal / client meetings (virtually and / or in person) as it relates to the mandate and participates in all key reoccurring meetings regarding TLR; Release Management; JAD sessions; client reviews
Oversees the various aspects of client business operations, regulatory, statutory and industry standards bodies to understand and ensure appropriate and timely communication of business requirements for client consumption in collaboration with internal and external teams
Acts as an escalation point for Client Account Managers on incidents/service requests and the client if resolution is not attained timely / accurately
Supports Business Development & Relationship Management with new product onboarding opportunities as required.

Leadership and People Management

Completes performance reviews; successions plans; establishing objectives in monitoring performance against plans; promotes training and professional development. Works closely with Human Resources on talent management
Provides performance feedback, coaching, mentoring and career and development planning for team members
Ensures continued employee engagement by promoting an “in the office presence” through participation in IFDS events; team meetings and events; internal working groups
Reviews current operating procedures, revising and implementing changes to improve service levels, productivity and cost effectiveness
Maintains current knowledge of financial; regulatory and operational issues affecting other departments and the company as a whole. Understands financial and operational goals of IFDS
Provides the team with support and recommendations on project prioritization and resource management
Oversees and provides the team guidance and direction with new opportunities with the development and discussion of operational enhancements to improve the client experience which may include but not limited to guidance with approach; test strategy and developing test plan and cases
Oversees and provides the team guidance and direction with new processes, policies and special initiatives as needed to enhance and support business needs.
Assists VP Account Management with salary administration; capacity planning and staffing plans

Minimum Qualifications

Demonstrated superior leadership skills including collaboration; relationship building; coaching; integrity; resilience to a fast paced; high stress environment; ownership and accountability, credibility, and consensus building
Demonstrated proficiency in communicating complex business solutions with clients & internal stakeholders
Solid technical knowledge of IFDS applications (including iFast, IFWP, etc).
Good knowledge of Segregated Fund, RESP, GIA/DIA, Guarantee Fee, FHSA product/iFast functionality.
Strong Change Management capability (ADKAR)
Highly analytical with a very high degree of attention to detail
Strong research / information gathering / analytical and problem-solving skills - takes a logical approach to analyzing problems. Systematically researches information and explores alternatives to solve problems.
Post-secondary education in a related discipline
Minimum 10 years’ experience in the financial service industry in a client facing, relationship management or Operational capacity
Minimum 10 years’ experience in leadership/people management
Solid knowledge of financial mutual fund record keeping systems and transfer agency operations
In depth knowledge of the mutual fund and banking industry of financial investment markets, trends and competitive framework
Understanding of investment concepts and the ability to communicate a working knowledge of investment strategies and products
High level of competency with MS suite, including but not limited to; Excel, Visio, Word, Powerpoint.
Superior communication verbal and written skills, as well as high level of interpersonal skill to interact with senior business professionals
Ability to engage internal stakeholders across a number of different functional areas
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem solving/troubleshooting skills combined with the ability to draw meaningful conclusions from qualitative client feedback or large data sets
Demonstrated ability to innovate and develop new proposals/solutions
Ability to manage direct and indirect reports in a virtual team setting
Proven project management skills, with strong attention to detail and flexibility to handle multiple projects and changing priorities
Enthusiastic and proactive approach with meticulous attention to detail
Extensive experience working with IFDS tools and clients (understands the full picture) Able to handle or lead (as appropriate)complex projects major change

IFDS Canada encourages applications from all qualified individuals. Applicants with disabilities may notify us of any accommodation needed to support your participation in the recruitment process. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying. Please be aware that only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted for this position.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
jobs.description:
About The Lacroix Medical Group

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics
Operating Rooms
Biomedical Laboratory

The organization has experienced strong and sustained growth since its founding in 2009 and currently employs nearly 350 people. As part of its strategic plan, the Group aims to accelerate its national and international development.

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;
Ability to prioritize, make decisions, and manage effectively in a complex and evolving environment;
Excellent business acumen and the ability to communicate technological issues to senior management;
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken;
A valid driver's license, a vehicle, and significant availability for regular travel throughout the network.

The Leader Profile We Are Looking For

Beyond technological expertise, we are looking for someone who stands out for their ability to mobilize, structure, and deliver.

A positive and committed leader with a strong sense of Accountability, the ability to build high-performing teams, manage rigorously, challenge the status quo, and transform technological challenges into concrete solutions for the business. The IT Director must be equally comfortable discussing strategy with senior management and understanding the challenges faced by teams in the field. Conditions and Compensation Lacroix Medical Group offers a competitive total compensation package including: Annual salary of $140,000 to $175,000, depending on experience and expertise; 4 weeks of vacation and 4 paid personal days; RRSP+ program with employer contribution; Cell phone allowance; Lacroix Health Credit; and an annual Lacroix gift card. This benefit can be combined with other benefits for personalized medical services.

Business travel expense account for trips outside your usual work area

Join a growing network and become a key player in the future of private medicine in Quebec.

Apply now and make a real difference.

Together, the work we do connects people and changes lives — including your own.

Be part of a dynamic, collaborative and caring organization committed to saving and improving lives. Thousands of patients depend on us every day for reliable access to safe blood, plasma, stem cells and organs and tissues.

About The Role

Canadian Blood Services is seeking a Regular Full-Time Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization
to join our Enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management Office (ePMO)
team in our Ottawa or Toronto office.

The ePMO
team delivers programs and services that advance valuable organizational initiatives, ensuring they are completed on time and on budget. Our focus is on maximizing business outcomes for Canadian Blood Services and the people in Canada we serve.

As the Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization, you will lead value realization and benefits tracking activities aligned with corporate strategy, corporate funding cycles, and the delivery of high-visibility projects and programs across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Program Enablement & Project Management Office, you will lead ePMO-led value realization activities across enterprise programs and provide guidance to support value-informed decision-making. You will contribute to enterprise portfolio management and reporting for all corporate priority projects, including ePMO projects; escalate issues requiring executive attention; and provide leadership to enterprise projects coordinated through process management. You will also ensure compliance with corporate portfolio reporting requirements and support the execution of select projects within the portfolio by fostering collaboration and integration across divisions. In addition, you will provide a challenge function across other ePMO activities, including reporting, automation and artificial intelligence (AI), data and analytics, and alignment with corporate strategy.

Formula for success

Leveraging your skills in ePMO operations, you will oversee value realization driven through programs, providing leadership, coordination, and management of enterprise PMO processes and functions.
Applying your expertise in value realization leadership, you will oversee the development of proposals and business cases, as required, to help articulate anticipated benefits and the value proposition.
Demonstrating your skills in influencing and negotiating, you will motivate and coach staff for high performance, act with transparency, and promote a problem-solving mindset and collaborative culture.
Utilizing your experience in benefits management and performance measurement, you will ensure all centrally delivered projects and programs have defined benefits, measured using key performance indicators, tracked, and communicated in a consistent and effective manner, and incorporate effective change and risk management controls.
Drawing on your skills in project interdependency management and prioritization, you will identify, manage, and address interdependencies between projects and prioritization to drive the greatest value.
Demonstrating your ability to lead with empathy and emotional intelligence, you will apply the advanced soft skills required to lead and motivate others to achieve deliverables, particularly when priorities and expectations may be in conflict.
Contributing your expertise in strategic initiatives and project leadership, you will take a lead role in developing and maintaining various initiatives and participate in special projects and corporate initiatives as assigned by the Director.
Applying your skills in performance improvement and governance, you will identify opportunities to improve performance and apply fit-for-purpose processes that balance governance and empowerment.
Fostering your strengths in people leadership and talent development, you will create a high-performing, engaged, and inclusive team environment by setting clear expectations, developing talent, supporting career growth and succession planning, and promoting continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development.
Applying your analytical and problem-solving skills, you will use your seasoned experience and knowledge to analyze highly complex problems, interpret business needs, and develop integrated, innovative solutions. This will often require deeper investigation of conflicting information and novel thinking to establish solutions.

Desired Education And Skills

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Science, Public Administration, Health Administration, or a related discipline. A master’s degree (MBA, MPA, MSc, or equivalent) is considered an asset. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.
A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience managing multiple projects and programs involving large teams, significant budgets, and multiple stakeholders, including at the executive level.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead teams, including managing, coaching, and developing project managers, employees, and contracted resources.
Proven ability to manage a significant project portfolio within a large organization, with a focus on value realization and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success in establishing and maturing value-driven portfolios and programs that support organizational transformation and strategic objectives.
Expertise in process transformation and service delivery, including the ability to develop recommendations and present outcomes to executive leadership.
Strong analytical and technical capabilities, with the ability to leverage portfolio reporting, data analytics, performance metrics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve decision-making, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Knowledge of corporate planning, budgeting, and financial management processes that support effective portfolio management and prioritization.
Familiarity with introducing new products or processes within a regulated environment is considered an asset.
Knowledge of managing and implementing process changes within a unionized workforce environment is considered an asset.
Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain project and portfolio documentation, reports, business cases, and executive-level presentations.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working within Agile teams is considered an asset.
Proficiency with relevant project and portfolio management tools, including Microsoft Project Professional and Microsoft Project Online (MSPO), is considered an asset.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including collaboration, facilitation, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement.
Strong financial and operational planning capabilities, with the ability to align resources, budgets, and priorities with organizational objectives.

What We Offer You

4 weeks’ vacation.
Comprehensive group health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family.
Annual performance award of up to 10%.
Defined benefit pension plan.
Employee discounts, wellness programs, and access to professional development resources.

What You Can Expect

This role requires a minimum of 40% on-site presence at 1800 Alta Vista Drive, Ottawa, Ontario or 67 College Street, Toronto, Ontario. Additional on-site work may be required based on business needs. On-site expectations are subject to change and may be adjusted on a temporary or permanent basis.
You will work Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, 7.5 hours per day.
Travel is required to attend meetings and to fulfill project commitments.

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply by providing your up-to-date resume. This could be your first step towards a meaningful and inspiring career. Come to work each day knowing that you save lives.

We acknowledge that the work of Canadian Blood Services spans many Territories and Treaty areas across the country, and we are grateful for the Traditional Knowledge Keepers and Elders who have guided us in this important work. We recognize the land and waters that have inspired our work and offer gratitude to those Indigenous peoples on whose territory we work, live and play.

Diversity and inclusion play a vital role in ensuring health equity for patients across Canada. We are committed to reflecting Canada’s population in our organization and fostering an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves, with equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

We thank all applicants for their interest. However, only those considered for an interview or those invited to participate in an assessment will be contacted. Applicants who require accommodation should discuss their needs with us.

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. Who You Are

Geotab is looking for entrepreneurial product and business leaders to head our domains – focused teams that each own a customer outcome and the business results that come with it. As a Head of Domain, you'll own the strategy, roadmap and results for your area, lead a multi-disciplinary team of product managers, designers and engineers, and turn customer problems into products that customers adopt and pay for.

What You'll Do

This is a role for someone who has
built and sold something
: a leader who measures success by business results, not by what shipped, and who uses AI to change how work gets done. You'll report to Geotab's Technology Development Board and operate with real autonomy as the business owner of your domain.

Own the outcome. Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your domain and be accountable for its primary business results – adoption, revenue, retention and customer impact.
Run it like a business. Make clear build, buy and partner decisions, prioritize by customer and revenue impact, and say no when the return isn't there.

Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort.

Flex working arrangements
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program

Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

Our client is a highly respected, mission-driven not-for-profit organization dedicated to improving well-being and quality of life in the communities it serves. The organization is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Executive Leadership Team. Reporting to the CEO, the Vice President will provide enterprise-wide leadership across Finance and corporate services, while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team.

The organization delivers essential services to a large and diverse client base. Behind every service are countless financial, operational, and strategic decisions that turn resources into meaningful impact. As Vice President, Finance, the successful candidate will ensure the financial strength, insight, and discipline needed to advance the mission and support long-term sustainability.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an accomplished finance executive who combines strategic insight with operational leadership and wants to influence meaningful outcomes in a purpose-driven organization. More than a functional leader, the Vice President will be a key enterprise partner, helping shape strategy, support growth, and position the organization for continued success in a complex operating environment.

The Mandate

The mandate extends well beyond traditional financial stewardship. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the VP will help shape organizational strategy, support evidence-based decision-making, and ensure the long-term sustainability of an organization delivering critical services.

In partnership with the CEO, Board, and senior leadership team, the VP will provide strategic financial leadership across planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, audit, risk management, and compliance. A key priority will be supporting the organization through a period of growth and change. Using financial insights and performance data, the VP will help evaluate opportunities, inform strategic initiatives, and optimize the deployment of resources in a complex funding and operating environment. Beyond finance, the VP will provide executive oversight of key corporate services, including procurement and facilities, ensuring effective stewardship of organizational resources and infrastructure. new_jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: Vice President, Finance and Administration

REPORTING TO: President

Date of Preparation/Revision: November 2026

POSITION SUMMARY

Slemon Park Corporation is a provincial Crown corporation that manages a business and residential community focused on aerospace, training, and real estate development. The Vice President, Finance and Administration serves as the Corporation’s Chief Financial Officer (CFO). The role maintains a strong internal control environment and oversees the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial information and reporting. As a member of the senior management team, the Vice President contributes to strategic planning, analysis, and corporate direction. The role also leads risk management and supports the integrity, security, and stability of the Corporation’s information technology systems. The position requires advanced knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and a working knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) to guide the development and implementation of sound financial policies and procedures.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Financial Management and Accounting
Lead the Corporation’s financial management, accounting, reporting, budgeting, and compliance activities, including:
• Lead the preparation of annual operating and capital budgets.
• Manage the timely preparation of monthly financial statements, program reports, and reconciliations required by divisional managers.
• Monitor actual performance against budget and direct financial analysis, including identifying priorities for further review.
• Ensure timely filing of payroll and commodity tax remittances.
• Lead the year-end preparation of financial statements.
• Coordinate the year-end audit, review audit recommendations, and implement necessary changes.
• Prepare ad hoc reports and analyses that identify emerging trends and their potential impact on the Corporation’s strategic plan.
• Inform corporate strategy through analysis of trends, demographics, external policy developments, and internal divisional data.
• Advise all levels of management on financial management and accounting matters.
• Manage the Corporation’s cash flow and investments.
• Oversee compliance with the Corporation’s procurement and contracting policies.
• Develop and maintain accounting policies in accordance with GAAP and IFRS.

2. Leadership of Accounting and Human Resources Staff and External IT Services
Lead and guide the Corporation’s accounting and human resources staff. Ensure that transactions comply with GAAP, applicable provincial requirements, and the Corporation’s financial policies and procedures. Coach and motivate staff, provide opportunities for internal and external training, communicate strategic priorities, and provide the guidance and support needed to achieve assigned objectives. Lead and coordinate the relationship with the external IT service provider, including capital renewal planning, service-level requirements, and information security needs.

3. Policies, Procedures, and Risk Management
Lead the development and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, and controls that support consistent operations, protect assets from theft, fraud, and loss, and preserve confidentiality. Monitor changes in legislation, market conditions, and corporate strategy, and recommend responsive updates.

Key responsibilities include:
• Develop and update corporate policies, including the Whistleblower Policy and Procurement Policy.
• Design, implement, enforce, and evaluate accounting, human resources, and business continuity policies and controls to protect assets and maintain the integrity of financial reporting.
• Manage relationships with banking and investment institutions, including account access, new accounts and services, signing authorities, and service as an authorized signatory.
• Control access to information systems and ensure effective backup processes for administrative, property management, general ledger, hotel, food and beverage, and retail point-of-sale systems.
• Liaise with software and IT support providers to coordinate updates, resolve errors, and implement new features.
• Design and update corporate compensation scales.
• Manage the Corporation’s insurance policies.

4. Financial and Management Information Systems
Provide leadership in the timely development, review, and presentation of financial statements and management reports.

Key duties include:
• Manage deadlines for monthly and year-end statements and remittances by guiding and supporting accounting and human resources staff.
• Monitor accounting standards, identify new or changing requirements, and advise the Corporation on policy choices and updates.
• Review and approve monthly financial reports before distribution to end users.
• Work with managers, directors, and executives to ensure reports meet business needs, and implement changes or new reports as required.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell’s AI Fabric initiative is pioneering a secure, sovereign AI compute network across Canada. This transformative portfolio includes seven large-scale, high-density data centres, anchored by a 500 MW British Columbia supercluster and a future 1.2GW flagship site in Regina, Saskatchewan.

As Program Director, you will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the national data centre build program—orchestrating scope, schedule, budget, and cross-functional execution across multiple concurrent sites. You'll be the integrating force connecting construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls into one predictable, well-governed program, ensuring Bell delivers these mission-critical facilities on time, on budget, and to standard as the initiative scales aggressively nationally.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery accountability for the national data centre build program, integrating scope, schedule, budget, and quality across multiple concurrent sites.
Orchestrate cross-functional execution across construction, engineering, commissioning, procurement, and program controls, ensuring alignment to program objectives.
Establish and govern the program delivery framework—stage gates, milestones, governance cadence, and decision rights—across the portfolio.
Own the integrated master schedule and program-level budget, driving predictability, transparency, and schedule discipline across all builds.
Lead program-level risk management, change governance, and interdependency management, escalating and resolving systemic issues before they impact delivery.
Provide executive-level program reporting to AI Fabric and Capital Programs leadership, translating complex delivery status into clear, decision-ready insight.
Manage program financials, forecasting, and capital planning in partnership with finance and program controls.
Drive resource planning and prioritization across sites, balancing competing demands as the program scales
Build and mature Bell's program delivery capability at a formative stage, embedding repeatable processes, playbooks, and lessons learned across the fleet.
Serve as a senior point of escalation and executive interface for site directors, functional leads, and external delivery partners.

Critical Qualifications

15+ years leading large-scale capital program delivery, with direct experience on hyperscale or mission-critical data centres (multi-site / multi-billion-dollar portfolios preferred)
Proven track record owning end-to-end program delivery across multiple concurrent construction projects, not just single-project management.
Deep command of program management disciplines—integrated master scheduling, budget/cost control, risk management, and change governance.
Strong understanding of the full data centre delivery lifecycle—construction, engineering, MEP, and commissioning through to operational handover.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and align diverse cross-functional teams and external delivery partners.
Expertise in program governance, stage-gate frameworks, and executive reporting.
Exceptional executive presence, able to influence and challenge senior engineering, construction, finance, and executive leaders.
Experience building and maturing a program delivery organization from a formative stage.
